name: Evacuation Distance Check
description: Corridor length must not exceed code limit
message: Corridor too long (actual {value}m > limit {threshold}m). Add refuge passage or redesign evacuation route.

name: Fire Zone Area Check
description: Single fire zone area must not exceed maximum
message: Fire zone area exceeds limit (actual {value}sqm > limit {threshold}sqm). Add fire separation.

name: Emergency Exit Count Check
description: Rooms exceeding area threshold need sufficient exits
message: Room area {condition_value}sqm > {condition_threshold}sqm, only {value} exit(s), at least {threshold} required.

name: Evacuation Door Width Check
description: Door clear width must meet code minimum
message: Door width insufficient (actual {value}m < required {threshold}m). Widen the door.
